title: Spanning-tree entropy of the spectre tiling
plain: Find the growth rate of the number of spanning trees of large spectre-tiling patches, and show it is not a rational multiple of Catalan's constant.
math: Prove $\lim\frac{\log\tau(G_R)}{|V(G_R)|}=h$ exists for spectre patches and $h/G\notin\mathbb{Q}$, $G$ Catalan's constant.
